Foreign currency deposits may impact bank margins

Inflows from Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) or FCNR(B) deposits are anticipated to put pressure on the profit margins of banks. Additionally, capital goods companies are facing challenges due to a slowdown in order inflows during the second quarter and persistent commodity inflation.
